title: Revisiting Tabular Deep Regression: Objectives and the Limits of Global Early Stopping
abstract: arXiv:2610.13909v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: While deep learning models for tabular data have recently received significant research attention, the choice of objective functions for regression tasks remains an understudied degree of freedom. Several lines of research offer alternatives to the standard Mean Squared Error (MSE), but differences in datasets, backbones, and evaluation protocols make their practical benefits difficult to compare. In this work, we address this gap by performing a systematic re-evaluation of regression objectives across a broad collection of established tabular datasets and multiple neural backbones. Our comparison reveals that many proposed objectives provide limited or inconsistent gains over a properly tuned MSE baseline, while quantile loss yields consistent aggregate improvements over MSE across the tested backbones. translated_title: 重新审视表格数据深度回归：回归目标函数与全局早停的局限
translated_abstract: 尽管面向表格数据的深度学习模型近来受到大量研究关注，但回归任务中目标函数的选择仍是一个研究不足的自由度。若干研究方向提出了标准均方误差（MSE）的替代方案，但由于数据集、骨干网络和评估协议的差异，其实际收益难以相互比较。在本工作中，我们通过在广泛收集的成熟表格数据集和多种神经骨干网络上对回归目标函数进行系统性重新评估来填补这一空白。我们的比较表明，许多已提出的目标函数相对经过恰当调参的MSE基线只能带来有限或不一致的收益，而分位数损失在所测试的各个骨干网络上均能相对MSE取得一致的总体提升。随后，我们识别出即使采用这种强目标函数仍然存在的一个局限：具有不同目标噪声水平的区域会在不同的时机达到t……
tldr: 该论文系统性地重新评估了表格深度回归中的各类目标函数，发现分位数损失是唯一能相对调优后的MSE基线带来一致提升的目标函数，并进一步揭示了由于不同噪声水平的区域需要不同的训练时机，全局早停策略存在根本性局限。
en_tdlr: This paper systematically re-evaluates regression objectives for tabular deep learning, finding that quantile loss is the only objective yielding consistent improvements over a well-tuned MSE baseline, and reveals the limits of global early stopping since regions with different noise levels benefit from different training times.
